question: GNP at market price is measured as:

options.text: GDP at market price + Net factor income from abroad
NDP at factor cost + Net factor income from abroad

solution:
The correct answer is __**GDP at market price + Net factor income from abroad**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gross National Product (GNP) at market price is calculated by adding **Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA)** to **Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at market price**.
 
• **Formula:**GNP at Market Pri
